steps.title: welcome to naomi
steps.description: i'm here to be your emotional companion. let's get to know each other a little better.

steps.title: what should i call you?
steps.description: i'd love to know your name so our conversations feel more personal.

steps.title: what brings you here?
steps.description: select all that resonate with you. this helps me understand how i can best support you.

steps.title: how are you feeling right now?
steps.description: there's no wrong answer. just check in with yourself.

steps.title: what interests you?
steps.description: these help me personalize our conversations and insights.

steps.title: when do you prefer to chat?
steps.description: i can send you gentle reminders to check in.

steps.title: how often would you like to connect?
steps.description: we can always adjust this later.
options: Daily - I want to build a habit

steps.title: your privacy matters
steps.description: everything you share with me stays private. your conversations are encrypted and never shared. you're always in control of your data.

steps.title: one more thing
steps.description: i communicate in lowercase – it's just my style. it helps our chats feel more like talking to a friend than reading a textbook.

steps.title: you're all set!
steps.description: i'm excited to get to know you better. remember, i'm here whenever you need someone to talk to.
